scoring_justification: T1 recompute is infeasible because it would require re-running full MC simulations; instead we verify consistency between reported coexistence points and isotherm data and compare critical parameters to paper's reported values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for critical temperature and density of methane in (30,30) SWNT
hidden_assets.generation_method: Read directly from paper's Table 2: Tc=169.8 K, Gammac=0.200 g/mL
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported critical parameters, used as reference for exact-match scoring with tolerance.

outputs.description: Isotherm data from gauge-cell MC. The 180 K isotherm must be monotonic (density not decreasing as chemical potential increases).

schema.notes: Rows for subcritical temperatures provide coexistence data. Two additional rows with temperature column 'critical_temperature' and 'critical_density' respectively hold the fitted critical values in the saturation_mu_c column.

outputs.description: Coexistence parameters (saturation chemical potential, vapor/liquid densities) and fitted critical temperature and density.
Comparison of GCMC and gauge-cell MC densities in the stable/metastable regions. The absolute difference must be within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are plain text CSV files. The agent must write them to /app/outputs. The checker reads these files and compares against hidden paper-reported values and structural checks with tolerances.
